Specification: This specification models a trivial one-variable system with state variable i. The initial state sets i to 1, and the next-state relation is pure stuttering because it leaves i unchanged in every step. The temporal specification requires Init and then always stuttering steps under [][Next]_i, and it also defines an invariant Inv asserting i = 2 plus a record-valued alias that includes the current value of i, a string field, and a boolean field comparing i with i'.
